name: ngo-workspace
description: NGO Foundation - Full Stack Platform (Frontend + Backend)

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
